# Emily & Rachel Lynde

- [Emily](../character/emily.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The news quickly spreads through the neighborhood and school, leading Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to step in and assist [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) at his newly cleaned home, where he prepares to explain the backstory of his marriage.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) originally separated over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) before reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays to eat tea with the Harrisons, walks back across the fields with [Emily](../character/emily.md), and later puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while conversing with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal
